### Mango Dash — G4 *Friendship Is Magic*

**Who she is.** A recurring **young Pegasus background pony** with a peach/light-orange coat, pale-yellow mane and tail, amber eyes, and usually a blank flank. Watch for her in groups of Ponyville and Cloudsdale fillies; despite the “Dash,” she is **not Rainbow Dash** or a verified alter ego of hers. **“Mango Dash” is a fandom/wiki placeholder name**, not a confirmed name spoken in the television series. The specific person who coined it is unverified. [Character and appearance guide](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Mango_Dash).

**Recognizable moments.** She first appears playing beside **Aura and Ruby Pinch** in **“Dragonshy”**; appears in the flight-school flashbacks of **“The Cutie Mark Chronicles”**; joins the young ponies teasing Fluttershy in **“Hurricane Fluttershy”**; crowds into **“Twilight Time”**; and participates in the school election in **“Crusaders of the Lost Mark.”** She returns in later flight-school flashbacks, Rainbow Dash fan crowds, and Washouts audiences. A minor likeness is also identified in **IDW *Friendship Is Magic* #47**. **Speaking:** she is associated with the **group chant mocking Fluttershy** in “Hurricane Fluttershy,” but no independently verified solo dialogue or individual voice-actor credit was found.

**Another official-media label, not a secret identity.** Gameloft’s licensed mobile game uses **“Golden Pegasus Filly”** for the corresponding design; that is a descriptive game character name, not proof that the show officially named her Mango Dash. The in-game description presents her as a friendly foal who gives thoughtful gifts. [Game character entry](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Golden_Pegasus_Filly).
